calibrationEvidence.note: Owned typical Node CRUD fit from typical-v1-20260927c (engine 1.2.3, fit rungs typical-fit-20, typical-fit-100, typical-fit-200); one day and one region, 20–200 RPS fit, 300 RPS independent holdout. Applies only to the matching workload/topology within 20–300 RPS. Not evidence for generic typical applications. Cost is list price, not a measured bill.
calibrationEvidence.latencyBasis: P95 uses typical-p95-v1, validated on independent holdouts (not fit data): m5.large, 1–3 app servers, 100–300 total RPS, at most 300 RPS per node, db.r5.large. Holdout DB CPU stayed at or below about 28% with no connection errors. Not validated below 100 or above 300 total RPS or under database saturation. The 300 total-RPS cap and linear per-node extension above 300 RPS are extrapolations, not measurements. Evidence: https://github.com/canvascloudai/cwm-bench/pull/21. P50/P99 modeled from owned typical in-VPC internal-ALB k6 fit; prediction, not a measurement
calibrationEvidence.latencyP99Basis: owned typical in-VPC k6 P99 fit (unweighted diagnostic)

The following original typical-v1 fit notes describe non-P95 metrics only. typical application; basis provenance, not observed simulated output. Assumption intervals, not statistical confidence intervals. Owned typical fit applies only to the matching workload/topology within 20–300 RPS (20/100/200 fit, 300 independent holdout). Assumed in-VPC/internal-LB baseline; other provider/network paths are not measured. P99: owned typical in-VPC k6 P99 fit (unweighted diagnostic); typical fit uses only 20/100/200 RPS; 300 RPS is an independent holdout; 500 RPS is a diagnostic extrapolation, neither used to fit.
